Maharashtra CM States Drought Measures Underway After Pawar's Letter

Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis stated that the government is "doing needful" in response to a letter from Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) leader Sharad Pawar concerning drought conditions. Fadnavis indicated that steps have already been taken to alleviate the drought situation. The Chief Minister also referred to Congress leader Rahul Gandhi as an "anarchist."
